prompt: I want to distribute numbers 1-50 in 10 groups. In such a way that when you add all 5 numbers in a group, all groups would have an equal total sum.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] correctly identifies that the total sum of 1–50 is 1275, which divided by 10 groups gives 127.5, so equal integer group sums are impossible; it directly concludes impossibility for the requested 1–50 case. Candidate [2] gives an explicit grouping (consecutive blocks) but the group sums are not equal, and its final solution is truncated, so it does not answer the prompt correctly. Candidate [3] and [4] both fail to produce a valid equal-sum distribution for 1–50 and appear incomplete/erroneous in their arithmetic setup and/or provided group construction.
